blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `sdk.admin.search` set of methods used to send requests to Medusa's Admin API routes.

This method searches across entities. When the Search Module is enabled,
results come from its indexes; otherwise each entity is queried with the
same free-text `q` filter the list endpoints support.

Results are grouped per entity and paginated independently.

children.name: entity
children.description:
The entities / indexes to search, comma-separated.
When the Search Module is enabled, defaults to every registered index.
Otherwise defaults to the admin fallback entity set.

children.name: limit
children.description: Per entity, not across the response — each group paginates on its own.

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request.

children.name: tags
children.description:
Tags to cache data under for Next.js applications.

Learn more in [Next.js's documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/caching#fetch-optionsnexttags-and-revalidatetag).
